question: For the April–June 2026 quarter, compare YoY revenue growth and operating margin for AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
grading: Key points: (1) AWS and Google Cloud growth ±0.5pp and margin ±0.5pp from segment data; (2) Azure growth as disclosed (note cc basis if any); (3) explicitly states Azure margin is not disclosed; (4) labels MSFT's quarter as fiscal Q4 FY26
answer: For April–June 2026: AWS revenue grew 36.7927% YoY (USD 42,232 million / USD 30,873 million) and operating margin was 39.3564% (USD 16,621 million operating income / USD 42,232 million revenue). [G29-E1] Google Cloud revenue grew 81.7968% (USD 24,768 million / USD 13,624 million) and margin was 35.5862% (USD 8,814 million / USD 24,768 million). [G29-E2] Microsoft Azure and other cloud services grew 43% in fiscal Q4 FY2026; the call’s convention indicates the same rate in constant currency. Azure quarterly revenue dollars and Azure operating margin are not separately disclosed, so Azure margin cannot be calculated. Intelligent Cloud margin is a broader segment metric and must not be substituted. [G29-E3]

output.answer:
**Question:** For the April–June 2026 quarter, compare YoY revenue growth and operating margin for AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
*As of 2026-10-01*

| | Revenue (USD millions) | YoY revenue growth (%) | Operating income (USD millions) | Operating margin (%) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AWS — Q2 FY2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026 | $42,232 [1] | 37% [1] | $16,621 [1] | 39.4% [1] |
| Google Cloud — Q2 2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026 | $24,768 [2] | 82% [2] | $8,814 [2] | 35.6 [2] |
| Microsoft Azure — Q4 FY2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026 | Not disclosed [3] | 43% (GAAP and constant currency) [3] | Not disclosed [3] | Not disclosed [3] |
| Microsoft Intelligent Cloud (segment containing Azure) — Q4 FY2026, quarter ended June 30, 2026 | — | — | — | 40.6 [3] |

- AWS Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) net sales were $42,232 million, up 37% year over year as reported and also 37% excluding foreign exchange effects. [1]
- AWS Q2 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) operating income was $16,621 million, and Amazon disclosed an AWS operating margin of 39.4% of AWS net sales, versus 32.9% in Q2 FY2025 (quarter ended June 30, 2025). [1]
- Google Cloud Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) revenues were $24,768 million, up 82% year over year as reported. [2]
- Google Cloud Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) operating income was $8,814 million, an operating margin of 35.6% of Google Cloud revenues (Alphabet does not disclose a Google Cloud margin rate). [2]
- Google Cloud's Q2 2025 (quarter ended June 30, 2025) operating margin was 20.7%, from operating income of $2,826 million on revenues of $13,624 million. [2]
- Microsoft Azure and other cloud services revenue grew 43% year over year in Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026), the same 43% on a constant-currency basis, versus 39% growth in Q4 FY2025 (quarter ended June 30, 2025). [3][4]
- Microsoft does not disclose Azure revenue dollars; the closest disclosed figure is Microsoft Cloud revenue of $59.3 billion in Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026), up 27% year over year. [3]
- Microsoft does not disclose an Azure operating margin; the reportable segment containing Azure is Intelligent Cloud, whose Q4 FY2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) revenue was $39,306 million (up 32% GAAP, 31% constant currency) and operating income was $15,955 million, an implied segment margin of 40.6%. [3]
- On the Q4 FY2026 earnings call, the 58% operating margin cited appears immediately before the transition "Next, the intelligent cloud segment," so it describes the segment discussed just before Intelligent Cloud (Productivity and Business Processes) and is not an Intelligent Cloud or Azure margin. [5]

**Not available**
- Microsoft Azure revenue in dollars for the April–June 2026 quarter (Q4 FY2026): Microsoft reports Azure only as a growth rate ('Azure and other cloud services revenue increased 43%'); no Azure revenue dollar amount is disclosed in the earnings release or 10-K. [3]
- Microsoft Azure operating income and operating margin for the April–June 2026 quarter (Q4 FY2026): Azure is not a reportable segment; Microsoft discloses operating income only for Intelligent Cloud, Productivity and Business Processes, and More Personal Computing, so no Azure-specific operating margin can be derived from the filings. [3]

**Sources**
[1] AMAZON COM INC earnings release for Q2 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-07-30) (www.sec.gov, 2026-07-30, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872426000024/amzn-20260630xex991.htm

[3] MICROSOFT CORP earnings release for Q4 FY2026, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2026-07-29) (www.sec.gov, 2026-07-29, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000119312526323632/msft-ex99_1.htm
[4] MICROSOFT CORP earnings release for Q4 FY2025, 8-K EX-99.1 (filed 2025-07-30) (www.sec.gov, 2025-07-30, primary) https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/789019/000095017025100226/msft-ex99_1.htm
